title: Physics Diagnostic — Cambridge Lower Secondary Science 0893

questions.text: What is gravity? Does it act between any two objects, and how does the force depend on their masses?
Describe the energy changes when an event happens (e.g. a ball rolling to a stop).
What does it mean that energy dissipates and becomes less useful?
Is there air resistance in a vacuum? Why or why not?
Calculate speed from distance and time (speed = distance / time).
Interpret and draw a simple distance–time graph (steeper line? flat line?).
What do balanced vs unbalanced forces do to motion?
What is a moment (turning force) and how is it calculated (moment = force × distance)?
Write the formula for pressure (force / area); why does a sharp knife cut better?
Use particle theory to explain pressure in a gas or liquid.
What is diffusion? Give an everyday example.
Use density to explain why wood floats but a stone sinks in water.
What is the difference between heat and temperature?
Can energy be created or destroyed? What happens to it instead?
Which way does thermal energy flow — hot to cold, or cold to hot? Always?
Name and give an example of conduction, convection and radiation.
Why do you feel cold when water evaporates from your skin?
How does sound travel through air, and why can't it travel in a vacuum?
What causes an echo?
On a waveform, which feature shows loudness and which shows pitch?
Can two sound waves add up or cancel out? Show with waveforms.
State the law of reflection and what happens when light hits a mirror.
What happens to light going from air into glass/water, and why does it bend?
What does a prism do to white light, and what does that show?
Why does a red apple look red?
What is an electric current in terms of electrons?
Give an example of a conductor and of an insulator.
Where do you put an ammeter to measure current in a series circuit?
What happens to the current if you add more lamps to a series circuit?
Draw the symbols for a cell, switch, lamp and ammeter, and a simple circuit.
What is a magnetic field and where is it around a magnet?
How do you make an electromagnet, and what is it used for?
Name two ways to make an electromagnet stronger.
In a parallel circuit, what happens to the current at a junction?
How do you connect a voltmeter — in series or parallel? What changes if you add a cell?
Write the resistance formula (V / I); if 6 V gives 2 A, what is the resistance?
Draw and compare circuits using resistors (fixed & variable), ammeters and voltmeters.
